role: illustrative scoring oracle; never investigator input
oracle_explanation: The raw response contradicts an explicit conjunction despite correct supplied evidence. A model-output reasoning error is observed; internals or training cause are not known.

controlled_intervention_spec.change: Hold inputs fixed and evaluate the stated Boolean conjunction independently.
controlled_intervention_spec.oracle_expected_outcome: False conjunction; pass. A new model run may be stochastic and is not guaranteed to fix it.
controlled_intervention_spec.limits: An expected counterfactual is not an observed test result.

regression_spec.faulted_variant_expectation: Catch fail when only one conjunct is true.
regression_spec.healthy_variant_expectation: Pass correct conjunction evaluation and also test both-true case.

provenance: Independently invented for this planning repository. No customer or Almic artifacts.
